subject: SpiralTech CAIQ: control narratives, evidence intake & remediation roadmap
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@spiraltech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping: control narratives and evidence intake

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, attached is an annotated CAIQ workbook that maps Redwood's controls to SpiralTech's CAIQ template. The goal for this thread is to establish: (a) a prioritized list of controls where we need supporting artifacts, (b) owners at SpiralTech for each evidence item, and (c) a short remediation/clarification roadmap for any gaps.

Quick summary of the attachment: Redwood_CAIQ_Annotated_v1.xlsx
- Tab "Crosswalk" contains CAIQ question IDs, our control reference (internal control id + system), and short narrative snippets.
- Tab "OpenItems" lists questions where we need artifacts or clarifications.
- Tab "Owners" is a suggested assignment table you can modify.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please review the OpenItems tab and assign internal owners (we included suggested owner emails).
2) Share any internal artifacts you can (log samples, policy snapshots, architecture diagrams) via the Drive link below or email to security@spiraltech.com.
3) If helpful, we can run a 45-minute walkthrough with the owners this Thursday (2027-08-13) to triage evidence.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cspiraltech-caiq-walkthrough

Ive also attached a short PDF with control narratives that align to the CAIQ sections (control-narratives.pdf) and a CSV checklist that SpiralTech can use to mark evidence readiness (evidence-checklist.csv).

Let me know which owners youve assigned and whether Thursday works. If not, propose two windows and well follow.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_CAIQ_Annotated_v1.xlsx (xlsx), control-narratives.pdf (pdf), evidence-checklist.csv (csv)
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@spiraltech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@spiraltech.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping: control narratives and evidence intake

Jonas,

Appreciate the package — looks thorough. A few quick clarifications from our side after a first pass:

- On the Crosswalk tab, question CAIQ-PL-2 (Data retention policy) — we have a retention policy doc but its organization-level. Would that suffice or do you need a Redwood-specific retention excerpt?
- For CAIQ-AU-1 (Logging and monitoring): we can provide exemplar log extracts, but we need to understand the exact time windows and log types you require (auth logs vs application logs).
- Several items in OpenItems are assigned to "infra@spiraltech.com" — Ill spin up owners but would like Redwood to call out minimal acceptable evidence per item so we can prioritize.

Thursday 2027-08-13 is tight for several owners. Can we aim for Friday 2027-08-14 10:00–10:45 PT or Monday 2027-08-17 14:00–14:45 PT?

Also can you confirm whether any items in your crosswalk are expected to require redaction (e.g., IP addresses, account ids) before we upload?

Thanks,
Avery Collins
Head of Vendor Security
SpiralTech

On Mon, Aug 10, 2027 at 3:22 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Avery,
> 
> Thanks again for the time earlier...
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@spiraltech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, security@spiraltech.com
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping: control narratives and evidence intake

Avery —

Thanks for the rapid review and good questions. Responses inline: 

- Retention: organization-level retention policy is fine as long as it clearly covers systems that process Redwood data. If you can highlight or point us to the relevant section, that will be sufficient. We may request a shorter excerpt for export, but we can accept a redacted PDF of the org policy.

- Logging: auth logs (successful/failed logins, token creation) plus application access logs for endpoints that process customer data would be the priority. For the initial artifact, a 2-week sample window is fine (annotate start/end timestamps). We will not need complete raw logs initially — masked samples are acceptable as long as timestamps and event types are intact.

- Minimal acceptable evidence: attached is an evidence-checklist.csv pre-filled with the minimum artifact type we typically accept for each CAIQ family (e.g., policy pdf, diagram png, log sample csv, SOC2 report summary). Use that as the prioritization guide.

- Redaction: please redact PII and any internal-only tokens/keys. IP addresses can be redacted unless you are comfortable sharing ranges. We can sign an MSA addendum if SpiralTech legal prefers a specific upload mechanism.

Given owner availability, lets schedule the walkthrough Monday 2027-08-17 14:00–14:45 PT. Marissa and Ben will join to triage the OpenItems. Calendar invite coming from my account.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: updated_evidence-checklist.csv (csv)

- CAIQ-AU-1 (Logging): assigned to Tariq Hassan (tariq.hassan@spiraltech.com)

Were set for the Monday walkthrough. See you then.

Best,
Avery

SpiralTech
